_comment: Tikbalang: single fused piece, no detachable props. Joint positions measured on tikbalang_rigready.blend (its own units, 0.977 tall; faces -Y, its left is +X). Left side only; the right side is mirrored. Used by tools/blender/rig_humanoid.py, because Mixamo's auto-rigger refuses this body. 'ankle' is the horse hock, 'toe' the top of the hoof, 'head_end' the muzzle.
